command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== RDKit: exact cheminformatics identities on aspirin =="
python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors as rd, Descriptors
smi="CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O"   # aspirin
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:22s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
can=Chem.MolToSmiles(m)
rt=Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.MolFromSmiles(can))==can
# canonical SMILES is idempotent under a round-trip -- exact
check("canonical_roundtrip", rt, f"{rt}  want True (canonical SMILES stable)")
# molecular formula -- exact graph property
check("formula", rd.CalcMolFormula(m)=="C9H8O4", f"{rd.CalcMolFormula(m)}  want C9H8O4")
# InChIKey against the PUBLISHED value (PubChem CID 2244) -- a reference identity,
# effectively a checksum of the molecular graph verified against an external source
ik=Chem.MolToInchiKey(m)
check("inchikey_published", ik=="BSYNRYMUTXBXSQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N", f"{ik}  want BSYNRYMUTXBXSQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N (aspirin)")
# ring count, heavy-atom count -- exact
check("ring_count", rd.CalcNumRings(m)==1, f"{rd.CalcNumRings(m)}  want 1")
check("heavy_atoms", m.GetNumHeavyAtoms()==13, f"{m.GetNumHeavyAtoms()}  want 13")
check("mol_weight", abs(Descriptors.MolWt(m)-180.16)<0.01, f"{round(Descriptors.MolWt(m),2)}  want 180.16")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
